title: Boundary properties of trailing-one removal
statement: For every Boolean word $w$, let $v$ be the word obtained by removing all trailing $1$s from $w$. Then $|v|\le |w|$ and the prefix of $w$ of length $|v|$ is $v$. Every bit of $w$ at an index $r<|w|$ with $|v|\le r$ is $1$, and whenever $r<|w|$ and $|v|=r+1$, the bit of $w$ at index $r$ is $0$.
hypotheses_covered: $r$ is a natural number with $r<|w|$ in each indexed assertion
